correctness.rationale: For r successor bits, the all-agree indicator is product(x_i)+product(1+x_i) over F2. At r=0 or1 it is constant1; at r>=2 cancellation of leading degree-r terms leaves every degree-(r-1) monomial with coefficient one, so algebraic degree exactly r-1. Thus coordinatewise Boolean affine iff every row has at most two successors. In that case Delta(x)=1+Bx where every B row has weight0 or2; B1=0 gives Delta^k(x)=1+B^k x for all k>=1. The first stable rank index a>=1 identifies Fitting decomposition ker B^a plus U=im B^a, with B|U invertible; equality of operator iterates is exactly B^{k+p'}=B^k iff k>=a and ord(B|U) divides p'. For n<=2 stable image dim<=1 implies p=1. At n3 the explicit 3x3 matrix yields period3. For each odd n>=3, B=I+P for a cyclic permutation has minimal polynomial (t+1)^n-1=t*g(t), g degree n-1 with g(0)=1; the order p of B|U obeys deg(g)<=p, hence p>=n-1. Independent direct matrix/valuation checker verified all 15002 at-most-two-successor frames n<=4, 237068 valuation cases, and odd-cycle periods n=3,5,7,9 equal 3,15,7,63. These finite tests corroborate but do not replace the universal ANF/Fitting/minimal-polynomial proofs.
